verdicts.reason: Both fall apart the same way. The two food photos are shrunk to thumbnail-sized crops inside their panels, which leaves big empty peach and pattern blocks, and the white frame is left as an empty box. The flourish dividers float between elements as stray arrows, the wrapped 'New pasta menu' headline is crowded against the left edge, and the brand block on the right is too small to read. B's only difference is slightly looser spacing in 'RESTAURANT' and the URL, so neither is the better resize.
